answers.answer: Claim agent-ready work with `pnpm issue:claim --count <n> --agent <name>`; use the explicit `--issue` form when selecting one issue. When the PR opens, run `pnpm issue:review --pr <pr> --issue <issue>`; add `--claim-id <claim-id> --rebind-branch` if the PR branch was created after the claim. If work cannot continue, run `pnpm issue:release --issue <issue> --claim-id <claim-id>` to return it to `agent-ready`, or add `--needs-grooming` when the remaining work is unclear. Add `--closed-unmerged-pr` after a stored PR closes unmerged. For an open issue after a partial merge, use `--merged-pr --needs-grooming`.

evidence.supports: Defines the ready and unclear states, the claim command, the review command, and the rebind variant.
Lists the claim, review, normal release, needs-grooming release, closed-unmerged release, and partial-merge release command forms.
